scope.description: AsyncStorageWrites RawNode entry-completion consumption across increasing raft terms, with serialized state-machine access and contract-compliant ordered local append work.
assumptions: Response was produced by the same RawNode instance and returned unchanged after its storage work completed.
No crash/restart of that instance between marker production and consumption.
Response has no snapshot and no event interleaves within its synchronous Step call.
excluded: Crash durability and stable-storage overwrite consequences

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No implementation edits. Same-package read-only access observes raft term, committed/applied indexes and unstable offset.
MemoryStorage substitutes for noncrashing stable storage; it is not an instrumented disk implementation.
Normal-entry application is modeled as immediate ordered no-op application before returning its attached completion; no state-machine payload effects are claimed.

plan_uncertainties: MemoryStorage and a consistent supplied snapshot prefix do not establish physical durability or a process-birth history.
No suffix replacement, runtime snapshot, crash or end-to-end client consistency consequence is checked.
Unstable offset is the selected prefix-truncation observable; payload preservation and arbitrary state mutation are outside this proposition.
